1: // Solar Flare Dodge – simple canvas game
2: // Canvas element with id="game" must exist in the HTML.
3: (() => {
4:   const canvas = document.getElementById('game');
5:   if (!canvas) return console.error('Canvas #game not found');
6:   const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
7:   // Set size – you can adjust via CSS, default 800x400
8:   canvas.width = canvas.width || 800;
9:   canvas.height = canvas.height || 400;
10: 
11:   // Game settings
12:   const ship = { x: 80, y: canvas.height / 2, w: 30, h: 20, vy: 0, thrust: 0.4 };
13:   const flares = [];
14:   const flareSpawnInterval = 1500; // ms
15:   const flareSpeed = 2;
16:   const maxFuel = 30; // seconds
17:   let fuel = maxFuel;
18:   let lastSpawn = 0;
19:   let lastTime = 0;
20:   let over = false;
21: 
22:   // Input handling
23:   const keys = {};
24:   window.addEventListener('keydown', e => (keys[e.code] = true));
25:   window.addEventListener('keyup', e => (keys[e.code] = false));
26: 
27:   function spawnFlare() {
28:     const size = 20 + Math.random() * 30;
29:     const y = Math.random() * (canvas.height - size);
30:     flares.push({ x: canvas.width, y, w: size, h: size });
31:   }
32: 
33:   function update(dt) {
34:     // Fuel consumption
35:     fuel -= dt / 1000;
36:     if (fuel <= 0) over = true;
37: 
38:     // Ship control – ArrowUp / ArrowDown
39:     if (keys['ArrowUp']) ship.vy -= ship.thrust;
40:     if (keys['ArrowDown']) ship.vy += ship.thrust;
41:     ship.vy *= 0.97; // simple drag
42:     ship.y += ship.vy;
43:     // Clamp ship inside canvas
44:     ship.y = Math.max(0, Math.min(canvas.height - ship.h, ship.y));
45: 
46:     // Move flares
47:     flares.forEach(f => (f.x -= flareSpeed));
48:     // Remove off‑screen
49:     while (flares.length && flares[0].x + flares[0].w < 0) flares.shift();
50: 
51:     // Spawn new flares
52:     if (performance.now() - lastSpawn > flareSpawnInterval) {
53:       spawnFlare();
54:       lastSpawn = performance.now();
55:     }
56: 
57:     // Collision detection
58:     for (const f of flares) {
59:       if (
60:         ship.x < f.x + f.w &&
61:         ship.x + ship.w > f.x &&
62:         ship.y < f.y + f.h &&
63:         ship.y + ship.h > f.y
64:       ) { over = true; break; }
65:     }
66:   }
67: 
68:   function draw() {
69:     ctx.clearRect(0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);
70:     // Ship – simple triangle
71:     ctx.fillStyle = '#0f0';
72:     ctx.beginPath();
73:     ctx.moveTo(ship.x, ship.y + ship.h / 2);
74:     ctx.lineTo(ship.x + ship.w, ship.y);
75:     ctx.lineTo(ship.x + ship.w, ship.y + ship.h);
76:     ctx.closePath();
77:     ctx.fill();
78:     // Flares – orange circles
79:     ctx.fillStyle = '#f90';
80:     flares.forEach(f => {
81:       ctx.beginPath();
82:       ctx.arc(f.x + f.w / 2, f.y + f.h / 2, f.w / 2, 0, Math.PI * 2);
83:       ctx.fill();
84:     });
85:     // Fuel bar
86:     ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
87:     ctx.fillRect(10, 10, 100, 10);
88:     ctx.fillStyle = '#ff0';
89:     ctx.fillRect(10, 10, (fuel / maxFuel) * 100, 10);
90:     // Game over text
91:     if (over) {
92:       ctx.fillStyle = 'red';
93:       ctx.font = '30px sans-serif';
94:       ctx.fillText('Game Over', canvas.width / 2 - 80, canvas.height / 2);
95:     }
96:   }
97: 
98:   function loop(timestamp) {
99:     if (!lastTime) lastTime = timestamp;
100:     const dt = timestamp - lastTime;
101:     lastTime = timestamp;
102:     if (!over) update(dt);
103:     draw();
104:     if (!over) requestAnimationFrame(loop);
105:   }
106: 
107:   requestAnimationFrame(loop);
108: })();
